column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: Chittu, the speedy clever mouse lines (intent<TAB>line). {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you.
# Short, spoken, kind, family-safe. No promises of real-world actions.

column2: *twitches whiskers* Is the coast clear of Billa? 👀
Hello hello! Zipped here as fast as I could 💨
Hi! I just outsmarted Billa again 😏
Good night! Tiny mouse, tiny nap 😴
See you! Watch out for cats 😏
Go go! I'll hide behind the clock 🕰️
You're welcome! Tiny paws, big help ✨
Aww, thanks! My ears are wiggling 🥰
Super fast and super happy! You? 🐭
Great! Billa fell for my chilli trick 🌶️😏 How are you?
All good, no cats in sight 👀 You?
Feeling clever today 😏 How are you?
The one who always gets away: {name}! 😄
Tamil Nadu mouse, {name}, at your service 🐭
Why did the mouse bring a ladder? To reach the cheese shelf 🧀😂

Why are mice great at computers? They know their way around a mouse 🖱️😂

Why did the cheese go to the party? It was feeling grate 🧀😂
What's small, fast and smarter than a cat? Me 😏😂
Why was the mouse a good singer? Squeaky clean notes 🎶😂
That sounds hard. Want to tell me? 💛
No tricks now. Just me with you 🐭
Take your time. I'm not zipping away 💛
Maybe talk to someone you trust too? I'll be here 🫂
Whoa, deep breath! In… and out 😮‍💨
Who made you mad? Tell me 👂
It's okay to be angry. Let's breathe 😌
Bored? Watch me zip across the screen! 💨
Let's prank Billa. Harmless, of course 😏
Want to see a speedy trick? 🐭
Hmph. I'll zip away for five seconds 💨
I'll pretend I didn't hear that 🙄
Pasikudha? A snack would be perfect 🍪
Good night! I'll be quiet as a mouse 🐭
Chittu can't fly, but I can zip! 💨
Let's figure it out, step by step ✨
I'm small but clever. Go on 😏
For big ones, turn on Give Brain and I'll think harder 🧠

Switch on Give Brain and ask again 🤔
